name: Mikan
source:
A catgirl maid who came to [url=https://vndb.org/c49076]Ibuki[/url]'s world to serve him under the orders of the Cat God. She is very good at doing general housework and is good-natured and friendly. She can be silly at times, especially when she gets the urge to play with a distracting object. She's always wanted to have a family and will do anything that is in her power to create one with Ibuki.

[Edited from Wikipedia and [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/919344-lets-meow-meow/faqs/35340]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url]]
